title: Quatrain Package Interchange & Application Composition Specification (v1)
description: Explicit JSON schema for Quatrain packages, skills, UX components, and service manifests.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for IDE validation and autocompletion.

extends.description: Relative path to base metadata file (e.g. package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml) to inherit name, version, description.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the package/skill. Inherited from base metadata file if 'extends' is specified.

version.description: Semantic versioning string (e.g. 0.1.0). Inherited from base metadata file if 'extends' is specified.

description.description: Concise summary of the skill or component responsibility.

icon.description: Emoji character or SVG icon identifier for UI rendering.

kind.description: The category kind of the Quatrain extension.

fields.description: Declarative list of configuration fields required to activate the extension.

capabilities.description: Optional capability flags (e.g. MCP support, storage requirements).

name.description: Unique key name of the field variable.

label.description: Human-readable UI label for the field.

required.description: Whether the configuration field is mandatory.

default.description: Default initial value for the field.

options.description: Available option list when field type is 'select'.
